runtime.browsers: Modern evergreen browsers supporting Fetch API, AbortController, and crypto.randomUUID
runtime.framework: TypeScript SDK Library + Node HTTP Dev Server (src/server.ts)

authentication_and_authorization.strategy: Caller-supplied short-lived Bearer JWT via TokenProvider / RefreshableTokenProvider
authentication_and_authorization.origin_binding: Bearer tokens attached only to configured trustedOrigin with redirect: manual
authentication_and_authorization.browser_token_storage: In-memory only; localStorage/sessionStorage prohibited by policy
authentication_and_authorization.webhook_verification: Server-only HMAC-SHA256 verification via @digital-india/sdk/webhooks (dip-api X-Webhook-Signature & Cashfree base64 HMAC)

database_and_storage_ownership.notes: External SDK holds zero direct DB or R2 credentials; file uploads use validated upload-intent signed URLs.

DIPINDIA.relationship: Authoritative platform backend; bridged via dip-api and ApiSathiClient.getGatewayStatus()

dip-core.relationship: Schema-aligned minor-unit Money and error code semantics (no runtime dependency)

dip-infrastructure.relationship: CI, Node 22 runtime, and secret-free env standards

dip-ui.relationship: Optional browser consumer via browser-safe @digital-india/sdk entrypoint

dip-docs.relationship: Synchronized SDK guide and OpenAPI 1.0.0-foundation snapshot

dip-status.relationship: Compatible health probe consumer via client.health.getHealth()
